question: In India, during a meeting of the Legislative Assembly or Council, if there is no quorum, it shall be the duty of the ______ to adjourn the House or suspend the meeting.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Speaker/Chairman.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **Quorum **is the** minimum number of members required** to be present in the House before it can transact any business.
